name: Radiology and imaging centres

problems.words: No-shows on MRI slots waste our most expensive time
quick_ideas: Confirm tomorrow's MRI and CT slots by message, so cancellations come early
Keep a short list of patients happy to come at short notice, so freed slots can be filled.

workzap_build.text: machine-wise booking with WhatsApp reminders, confirm and cancel replies and a waitlist, with no-shows measured per machine.

problems.ask_first: Which machine has the most no-shows?
problems.free_stops: Slot lengths per study and reminder timing are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Patients come without the right preparation and we have to reschedule
quick_ideas: Ask your radiologist to approve one written preparation sheet per study type, so instructions come from them
Count reschedules caused by preparation for a week, so the cost is visible.

workzap_build.text: preparation reminders sent automatically at booking and the day before, using only text supplied and approved by your radiologist.

problems.ask_first: Who gives patients preparation instructions now?
problems.free_stops: Message timing and sequencing are in the solution document; the content always comes from your radiologist.

problems.words: Scans are done but reports take two days because the radiologist is backed up
quick_ideas: List studies awaiting report by age each morning, so the backlog is visible
Agree which studies are reported first, so urgent referrals aren't stuck behind routine ones.

workzap_build.text: a reporting worklist board showing studies by age and radiologist role, with escalation when overdue and average report time per day.

problems.ask_first: Are your radiologists on site or reporting remotely?
problems.free_stops: Priority and escalation rules are designed in the solution document.

problems.words: Teleradiology bills don't match the number of studies we sent
quick_ideas: Count studies sent last month and compare with the bill, so the gap is known
Ask the provider for a study-wise statement, so lines can be matched.

workzap_build.text: a monthly reconciliation of studies sent versus studies billed, with differences listed.

problems.ask_first: Do you use one teleradiology provider or more?
problems.free_stops: The matching method is in the solution document.

problems.words: CT went down for four days and the vendor took their time
quick_ideas: List each machine's service contract terms and response time in one place, so you can hold the vendor to them
Log each breakdown with start and end time, so downtime is on record.

workzap_build.text: a downtime and service log with vendor response times and contract terms on file, with alerts to the owner when a machine goes down.

problems.ask_first: Are your machines under an AMC?
problems.free_stops: Log fields and escalation are set in the solution document; contract disputes go to your lawyer.

problems.words: I don't know what each machine actually earns after lease and service
quick_ideas: Total last month's scans and revenue per machine, so you have a base
Add lease, service and power costs per machine, so the picture is complete.

workzap_build.text: a per-machine profitability view combining scans, revenue, lease, service and power, updated monthly.

problems.ask_first: Which machines are leased or on revenue-share?
problems.free_stops: Cost allocation is worked out in the solution document; for financial decisions talk to your accountant.

problems.words: Patients call ten times asking if the report is ready
quick_ideas: Tell patients at the counter when their report is expected, so they don't need to call
Count report-status calls for a few days, so the load is measured.

workzap_build.text: workflow_automation — a "report ready" notice sent to the registered contact with a secure link, with every send logged and no findings in the message.

problems.ask_first: How are reports handed over now, film, CD or link?
problems.free_stops: The delivery flow and link security are set in the solution document.

problems.words: Doctors who used to refer now send patients to the new centre
quick_ideas: List your top referring clinics and their monthly volumes, so drops are visible
Visit or call the ones that slowed, so you hear the reason.

workzap_build.text: a referral dashboard showing volume by referring clinic each month, flagging sudden drops.

problems.ask_first: Is the referring doctor recorded at booking now?
problems.free_stops: How referral data is captured at the counter is in the solution document.

problems.words: Cash at the counter doesn't match the scans done
quick_ideas: Do one shift close matching scans done against cash, card and credit, so the gap is sized
Ask for an approver on every discount, so leakage is visible.

workzap_build.text: a daily counter close by shift, matching scans with payments and listing discounts by approver role.

problems.ask_first: Do you run a night shift?
problems.free_stops: The close format is in the solution document.

problems.words: Old images are on a server nobody backs up
quick_ideas: Find out when the last full backup was taken, so you know your exposure
Ask your IT provider to confirm a backup schedule, so it is someone's job.

workzap_build.text: a backup check that alerts the owner if an archive backup fails or is missed.

problems.free_stops: The monitoring set-up is in the solution document.

never_say: Which scan someone needs, what a scan shows or the quality of a report.
Preparation, contrast or radiation advice; these are for the radiologist.
Interpretations of radiation-safety licensing or shielding rules.
Help issuing reports without a scan, altering findings or billing for scans not done.
Legal views on vendor contracts or misdirected reports; point to a lawyer.
Ideas that put names, images or report text in messages.

sample_reply.person: Our MRI has a week-long waiting list but I see the machine idle after 7pm. What can we do?
sample_reply.pi: Yes, there's room to use those evenings, and you can start checking this week. 1) Map one week of MRI use hour by hour, so you know exactly how many evening hours sit idle. 2) List what an evening shift needs in technologist and reporting cover, so the real blocker is clear. Workzap can do the tracking automatically for you with machine-wise booking, a waitlist and a reporting worklist, so evening slots can be filled and measured. Shall I have a solution document and quote prepared for you? You're welcome to say no.
